mintAuthority.headline: The extension mints against M, while an undelayed three-of-five multisig can replace its mint logic.
mintAuthority.summary: USD+ is minted by its Solana extension's mint-authority PDA. An observed Wrap transfers M into the exact extension vault before minting USD+. The extension remains upgradeable by a Squads vault requiring three of five members with no execution delay, so no immutable economic issuance bound is established. This is an asset-local control review; M0 platform membership does not substitute for USD+ control or assurance evidence.

review.evidence: Exact-slot bytes, matching slot context and before/after block headers establish the mint authority, extension global, ProgramData authority and current Squads upgrade threshold. The sampled Wrap independently proves which program signs USD+ minting and transfers M into its backing vault. Known undelayed upgrade reach keeps economic cap semantics unbounded; no full deployed execution certificate, immutable deposit-only constraint or signer-independence credit is asserted. Accessible USD+ disclosures do not establish a complete recurring reserve-to-all-liability reconciliation or token-specific supervised issuing entity. Parent M validator collateral monitoring does not resolve those USD+-local questions. Freeze authority is separately reviewed under FreezeWatch and is not treated as a mint power. The underlying M cross-chain transport is not native USD+ issuance and is not duplicated here as bridge-mint authority.
